items.source: Uses of InterceptingHttpAccessor in org.springframework.web.client
Synchronous client to perform HTTP requests, exposing a simple, template method API over underlying HTTP client libraries such as the JDK HttpURLConnection, Apache HttpComponents, and others.
items.translation: 同步客户端用于执行 HTTP 请求，通过底层 HTTP 客户端库（如 JDK `<code>HttpURLConnection`、Apache HttpComponents 等）提供简单的方法模板 API。
